area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: strict_word_similarity forces the matched extent to word boundaries, beside the older word_similarity for parts of words.

steps.formulation: similarity() compares the trigram sets of whole strings, with a threshold set by set_limit for the % operator.
steps.quote: provides functions and index classes for determining the similarity of text based on trigram matching.

steps.formulation: word_similarity() compares a string with the best-matching extent of another string (commit of 2016-03-16).
steps.quote: Patch introduces a concept of similarity over string and just a word from another string.

criticism.quote: word_similarity doesn’t seem to do exactly what the docs say, since it will match trigrams from multiple words rather tan doing a word by word comparison.

steps.formulation: strict_word_similarity() takes word boundaries into account (release 11).
steps.quote: strict_word_similarity is similar to existing word_similarity function but it takes into account word boundaries to compute similarity.
